about: Which database a statement goes to, read by scripts/test_lca_numbers.py and src/lib/db/__tests__/lcaRoute.test.ts so the Python and TypeScript copies of the rule agree. home: lca, main or null (transaction control). joins: the main-file tables a statement on lca_cases also names.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM lca_cases INDEXED BY lca_cases_emp WHERE employer_slug = ?

WITH f AS (SELECT wage FROM lca_cases WHERE x = 1),
 c AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM f),
 o AS (SELECT wage, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY wage) AS rn FROM f)
SELECT (SELECT n FROM c) AS n, (SELECT AVG(wage) FROM f) AS avg FROM o LIMIT 1
INSERT INTO lca_cases (case_number) VALUES (?) ON CONFLICT(case_number) DO UPDATE SET naics = excluded.naics
UPDATE lca_cases SET naics = ? WHERE case_number = ?
SELECT case_number FROM lca_case_numbers WHERE case_number > ?
SELECT 1 FROM perm_docs JOIN perm_cases USING (x)
SELECT 1 FROM lca_case_status s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lca_cases c WHERE c.case_number = s.case_number)
SELECT * FROM lca_cases l JOIN employer_page_map m ON m.source_slug = l.employer_slug
SELECT employer_slug FROM lca_cases UNION SELECT employer_slug FROM pwd_cases
